candidates.title: Find and book a flight quickly

demandEvidence.chore: tldr; Travelers wanted to find and book flights super fast in Claude, so we built this. -- BonBook started as flights via email because I was flying once a week in '24 and the UX got to me. Since then
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: tldr; Travelers wanted to find and book flights super fast in Claude, so we built this. -- BonBook started as flights via email because I was flying once a week in '24 and the UX got to me. Since then

ease.reason: A mock can organize traveler supplied dates and destinations, but no building reference supports search or booking integrations.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: frequent travelers might pay for faster flight planning; this launch post does not establish buyer demand or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could compare manually supplied options; live fares, availability and booking access are unsupported.

autonomy.reason: Option sorting could repeat, but a traveler must verify itinerary, price and authorize any purchase.

evidence.reason: The post says travelers wanted to find and book flights quickly; it gives no detailed requirements or independent corroboration.

candidates.reason: Rejected: the assigned segment is professional_services while the stated user is travelers, and the scope implies live travel search and purchase without implementation evidence; no supported pairing.
